# Generated by the ZIN content builder (tools/content/modules/warfare.mjs): Aoaz warfare, stage 2 of the vanilla removal.
# zin_war_grant_dragons: country scope. Input: the temp variable zin_arg_amount, the flights granted (a flight is 3 dragons).
# Raises zin_dragon_flights by the flights the realm has room for under the cap; with dragons in the skies adds the dragons
# (zin_dragon_equipment_0), Dragon Lore and the first air doctrine (zin_inst_air_start); with the sky rule none adds zin_war_dragon_ally for
# 180 days per flight instead. Fires the report zin_war.2. Called by the magic and world systems (zin_world_give_dragon).
zin_war_grant_dragons = {
	set_temp_variable = { zin_war_flights = zin_arg_amount }
	set_temp_variable = { zin_war_room = constant:zin_warfare.max_dragon_flights }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { zin_war_room = zin_dragon_flights }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_war_flights > zin_war_room } }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_war_flights = zin_war_room }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_war_flights > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { zin_dragon_flights = zin_war_flights }
		if = {
			limit = { zin_rules_skies_present = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_war_dragons = zin_war_flights }
			multiply_temp_variable = { zin_war_dragons = constant:zin_warfare.dragons_per_flight }
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = zin_dragon_equipment_0 amount = zin_war_dragons producer = THIS }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_tech = zin_tech_dragon_lore } }
				set_technology = { zin_tech_dragon_lore = 1 popup = no }
			}
			zin_inst_air_start = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { zin_war_days = zin_war_flights }
			multiply_temp_variable = { zin_war_days = constant:zin_warfare.dragon_ally_days }
			add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_war_dragon_ally days = zin_war_days }
		}
		country_event = { id = zin_war.2 }
	}
}
